_doc: Direct listing URL overrides per workbook rank. Edit by hand as you find canonical property URLs (the ones apartments.com / rent.com / etc actually serve when you drill past their category pages and DuckDuckGo redirects). Then run `npm run check:direct-listings` to probe each URL — the script updates `status` (live | redirected | gone | stale | untested) and `last_verified_at`. Status drives a UI pill so you see at a glance whether a unit is still listed or has been taken / removed.
